turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. Can you tell me a little about yourself?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Sure. I'm Ruth. I'm seventy... no, sorry, I'm seventy-two.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: No problem. Are you married, or are you on your own?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: My husband passed away three years ago, so I'm widowed.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What income do you have right now?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Just Old Age Security. I think it's around eight thousand eight hundred a year, but I'd have to check.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Do you also get the Guaranteed Income Supplement?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, I don't get that one.

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I rent a one-bedroom. It's twelve hundred a month.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Got it. When did you last file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: It's been a while, honestly. I think the last time was for 2021.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Do you have any dental coverage through work or a private plan?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, nothing private. I just go to the clinic when I need to.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thank you. Last question: are you a Canadian citizen?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I've been a citizen for decades.
